subject: Renewal & roadmap walkthrough — scheduling and final attendee list
messages:
From: Samantha Boyle <samantha@urbancare.io>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: itops@urbancare.io
Date: Sat, 9 May 2026 17:22:00 -0000
Subject: Renewal / roadmap walkthrough — can we lock a time?

Hi Laura —

We’re coming up on contract renewal next quarter and our execs want a short roadmap walkthrough + a product roadmap demo focused on the Enterprise features we discussed (dedicated pools, observability retention, and private deploy). I wanted to lock a date that works for both teams.

Proposed window: week of June 1–4, ideally a 60-minute slot where we can walk the roadmap and leave 15–20 min for questions. Attendees on our side: me, Michael Chen (IT Ops), and our Head of Product (TBD — likely joining for the first 30 mins).

Constraints: Michael is only available 14:00–18:00 US/PDT on June 2–4. Exec prefers mornings (PDT) but can move if needed. Can you share a couple of times and an agenda?

Attached: current stakeholder list (urban-stakeholders.xlsx).

Thanks,
Samantha Boyle
Head of Product
UrbanCare
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Boyle <samantha@urbancare.io>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, mina.haddad@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 02:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Renewal / roadmap walkthrough — can we lock a time?

Hi Samantha —

Thanks for the heads up and for the stakeholder sheet — that helps a lot. We can certainly run a focused 60‑minute session. Proposed agenda:

- 10 min: introductions & renewal context
- 25 min: roadmap highlights + committed timelines (Dedicated, Optimize, Private controls)
- 15 min: focused demo (billing/console + rollout policies)
- 10 min: next steps & action items (SLA/DocuSign/PO)

Availability from our side (all times PDT):
- Tues, Jun 1: 09:00–10:30, 15:30–17:30
- Wed, Jun 2: 15:30–17:30 (best for Michael per your note)
- Thu, Jun 3: 10:00–12:00

Can you confirm whether Wed Jun 2 16:00–17:00 PDT works for you and Michael? I’ve looped Karthik (AM) and Mina (CS) so we can cover renewal terms and the tech checklist. If exec wants to join only for first 30, that’s fine — we’ll keep the demo focused and timeboxed.

If that slot works I’ll send a calendar invite and share a short pre-demo checklist (runbook + required access).

Best,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
From: Samantha Boyle <samantha@urbancare.io>

Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 09:18:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Renewal / roadmap walkthrough — can we lock a time?

Hi Laura —

Wed Jun 2 16:00–17:00 PDT works for me and Michael. Executive will join for first 25–30 minutes (I’ll confirm name by Tuesday). Please include anything you need from our IT side (service account, sample logs access) in the checklist.

One ask: can we record the demo and get the slide deck? Our internal stakeholders who can’t make that slot will want the recording and tl;dr notes.

Thanks — I’ll look out for the invite.

Samantha

Laura / team —

Thanks for coordinating. A couple of operational notes before we send the invite:

1) Demo runbook: we should include a short pre-meeting checklist so UrbanCare can provision a read-only service account and enable API logs. I attached the runbook (demo-runbook.pdf) with exact steps.
2) Backup slots: in case the exec can’t join at 16:00 PDT, propose 09:30–10:30 PDT on Thu Jun 3 as an alternate.
3) Recording & deck: we’ll record, upload to the deal page, and circulate a one-pager summary. Marissa — can you own the deck and recording distribution?

Note: I’m out of office Jun 1–2 (heads up) but will be reachable by email if something is urgent. Mina will lead the call for renewal terms and SLAs on Jun 2.

Karthik Iyer
Account Manager — Redwood Inference

- Calendar event: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=urbancare-rdw-4721-20260602

- Marissa: please prepare the 10‑slide deck focused on Dedicated + rollout policies; include 1 slide on expected unit economics (tokens/cost).
